title: The Tortoise and the Rabbit
summary: An arrogant rabbit challenges the tortoise to a race. Who will arrive first?
moral: Arrogance makes us careless, while perseverance and hard work will carry us to the goal.
pages: The rabbit was famous as the fastest runner in the forest, and he was very proud. 'Look at my nimble legs!' he said. Nearby, the tortoise walked slowly and calmly.

'Tortoise, you walk so slowly!' teased the rabbit. The tortoise smiled and answered, 'How about we race to the flag at the edge of the forest?' The rabbit laughed out loud, then accepted the challenge.
One, two, three, go! The rabbit shot off like the wind, while the tortoise took one step after another. In a moment the rabbit was far ahead, and the tortoise was only a small dot.
'Ah, the tortoise is still far behind,' thought the rabbit. 'I will just sleep a little under this shady tree.' The gentle breeze lulled him, and the rabbit fell fast asleep.
The tortoise kept walking without stopping, without complaining. He passed the snoring rabbit, and kept stepping patiently, one step at a time.
The rabbit woke when the sky began to turn orange. He leapt up and ran as fast as he could, but it was too late! The tortoise had reached the finish line and was welcomed by the clapping of birds.

The rabbit bowed his head in shame. 'Forgive me, tortoise. I was too arrogant.' The tortoise answered kindly, 'It is all right. What matters is that we keep trying.' From then on they were good friends. The end.
